item.title: REF 0.18.1
item.description:
• The REF plug-in no longer crashes Logic when you keep the Match EQ in the mix (Settings › Plug-in › Match EQ) with the Tone tab open.
  • The plug-in's Settings, Library, Glossary and Meters windows now float with the plug-in window instead of hiding behind it.
  • In linear phase, a bounce with the Match EQ on listen only now comes out exactly as late as REF tells your DAW.
